supersedes: v1 execution block for the two named controls only; original v1 retained unchanged
scientific_claim_scope: inspected_published_52_phage_CSV_reference_only; no untouched release, productive infection or therapy claim

source_adjudication.panel_authority: exact pinned processed CSV roster: all 25 hosts x all 52 phages; do not expand to Table 8 matrix-marked phages
source_adjudication.unresolved_original_experiment_scope: reason for absence of four matrix-marked phages is unknown; no claim to reproduce a 56-phage panel

Bas64.evidence: original S5 and verified genome bytes agree
Bas64.interpretation: retain discrepancy; do not assert its cause or change any phenotype

host_assembly_policy.primary: all 25 published WGS assemblies from Supplementary Table 9, exactly as locked and sequence-audited
host_assembly_policy.sensitivity: all 25 corresponding original training assemblies, scored in a second complete panel; never choose the better build after scoring
host_assembly_policy.biological_identity_limit: assembly mismatch alone neither proves nor refutes the same biological strain
host_assembly_policy.feature_reuse: bind every vector to canonical assembly digest AND representation digest; host name is not a cache key
host_assembly_policy.preexisting_annotations: do not reuse by ECOR identifier; regenerate from actual admitted sequence

representation.implementation: src/phage_cocktail/host_genome.py:host_fourmers, applied identically to both hosts and phages
representation.windows: count within each contig only; skip any window containing non-ACGT IUPAC bases; do not remove ambiguity or join contigs
representation.normalization: divide by total valid 4-mer windows across all contigs; zero valid windows blocks the full-panel comparison
representation.feature_identity: SHA256 of little-endian float64 values in ordered_features order plus separately recorded assembly and representation digests
representation.fit_statistics: none; no label-dependent encoding, scaling, feature selection, weighting or calibration

uniform_random.scores: all zero; exact expected metrics over uniform within-tie permutations; no random sampling

canonical_4mer_cosine.interpretation: untrained sequence-composition control; not an infection probability
canonical_4mer_cosine.summation: fixed one-dimensional feature order per pair; no batched BLAS scoring

reporting.panels: uniform random shared reference, published-WGS cosine primary, original-training-assembly cosine sensitivity; report all three
reporting.primary: equal-host macro Hit@2 lower/upper identification bounds over all 25 hosts
reporting.unknown_exposure: exact expected fraction of top-K slots occupied by source-unknown pairs, including ties
reporting.cost: equal sequential test cost, stop at first positive or K; E[tests@K] = K - sum(Hit@j for j=1..K-1)
reporting.cost_bounds: lower cost from upper Hit bounds; upper cost from lower Hit bounds; no source label imputation
reporting.cosine_minus_random: conservative outer bounds [cosine_lower-random_upper, cosine_upper-random_lower]; not sharp joint-assignment bounds
reporting.assembly_sensitivity: publish both panels and per-host deterministic top-2 membership changes; do not pick a primary build from results
reporting.near_phage_sensitivity: retain all 52 candidates; report expected top-K exposure to the 8 candidates sharing training groups at 90% identity
reporting.uncertainty: identification bounds only, not confidence intervals; no host-group bootstrap without assembly-appropriate group validation
reporting.selected_pairs: named top-2 sets use score descending then lexicographic phage ID; separate from tie-averaged expected metrics
reporting.release_decision: never promote a model on these controls or inspected reference outcomes alone
